verdict.rationale: Missive publishes no OpenAPI or equivalent formal spec: every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returns 404, and its docs state that no OpenAPI spec is documented. The closest substitute is the REST endpoint reference, which can be downloaded as raw Markdown (append .md to any docs page) and is indexed at /docs/llms.txt. That gives agents a text reference to the API, but not a structured, schema-level spec. Missing for 10: a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger (or equivalent schema-based) spec file, machine-readable request/response schemas, and independent corroboration.
